company_name: Shenzhen GCL Environmental Protection Industry Co.,Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized cleaning and surface treatment solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shenzhen GCL Environmental Protection Industry Co., Ltd specializes in ultra-clean cleaning and surface treatment solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include advanced cleaning technologies such as megasonic cleaning and nano-coating, which are critical for maintaining cleanliness standards in wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing.

regional_presence.Malaysia: GCL has a subsidiary, GDT Surface Technology, providing surface treatment solutions.
